detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Play as the last pelican trying to restore the light back to a world swallowed by shadow. Journey through different seasons to rescue lost animals and defend fallen stars, then come back to your lighthouse to build a thriving settlement, where relationships with animals dictate their strength for the next fight.

The light of the world has been extinguished, will you and your friends be the ones to restore it?

Fly to pockets of light across a fog-covered world and protect the crash-landed stars from being snuffed out.

  • Select your animal companion loadout

  • Deploy animal towers, each with distinct abilities and upgrade paths

  • Utilize your pelican’s abilities to strengthen towers and help defend

  • Hold the line through escalating waves of shadow creatures

  • Earn Trust to strengthen animal relationships

The fate of the world is up to your strategy - so craft your loadout accordingly to adapt to new challenges and foes that may come your way.

Between battles, fly home to your lighthouse and transform an old abandoned settlement into a warm, living town.

  • House new animals, place decor to raise morale, and upgrade your abilities

  • Check-in with your animal neighbors to build up Trust & strengthen their respective towers

  • Discover the narrative through animalistic interactions

  • Unlock new powers and upgrades through the Cosmic skill tree

By strengthening your community and fostering relationships, the power of The Pelican and the towers you utilize with grow as well!

The crash-landed stars you defend are used to rebuild constellations which return light to the world.

  • Unlock and explore three unique regions

  • Meet new animals with new towers and abilities

  • Expand your strategic defensive options

Turn a ruined settlement into a beacon of hope strong enough to lift the shadow fog from the world.

  • A strategic tower defense adventure with base building elements

  • A customizable lighthouse town full of charming animals

  • 7 animal towers with unique abilities and upgrade paths

  • Tower Symbiosis system that buffs allies

  • 13 hand crafted levels spanning 3 unique seasons

  • 3 boss battles

  • A unique story told through an animal lens

  • A cosmic skill tree to upgrade and grow your strength over the course of the game
